## Report — Step C3: mount the EU language prompt in `_app`

**Bottom line: the storefront's first-ever uninvited modal is now wired end-to-end and the gate is green — 83 test files / 1238 tests / 0 failures, tsc clean, lint at the exact pre-existing baseline (zero new problems), token audit unchanged at 3.** Two of my own docblock citations turned out to be invented when I checked them against the real files — caught and fixed before finishing, details below.

### Files touched (exactly the 5 named, nothing else)

**Created:**
- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmLanguagePrompt/index.tsx`
- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmLanguagePrompt/index.stories.tsx`
- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmLanguagePrompt/index.test.tsx`

**Modified:**
- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/_app/index.tsx` — 2 lines added, 0 removed (1 import + 1 JSX mount). `git diff --numstat`: `2 0`.
- `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/_app/index.test.tsx` — 32 lines added, 0 removed, every hunk is additive-only (confirmed via full `git diff` review, not just stat).

**Untouched, confirmed:** `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmCountryLanguageMismatch/index.stories.tsx` still shows the same pre-existing uncommitted 65-line addition it had before I started (I only read it, never wrote to it). `theme/components/index.ts` untouched — this container needed no recipe (it renders `null` or delegates 100% of its JSX to `ZimmCountryLanguageMismatch`, which already owns its own styling).

### What the container does (mechanism)

`ZimmLanguagePrompt` takes `{site, locale, buildUrl}` as props (no `useMultiSite()` call of its own — `components.md`'s container rule only exempts `useIntl`/`useUiCopy`). One `useState` holding `{isOpen, targetLanguage}`, one mount-only `useEffect` that reads `navigator.languages` + the suppression cookie, asks `shouldShowLanguagePrompt`, and opens if told to. A `handleSwitchLanguage` writes the suppression cookie via `setRegionPrefCookie({...getRegionPrefCookie(), languageSuppressedAt: ...})` (spread-first, so it can never clobber the country prompt's still-unwritten `countrySuppressedAt` flag) **then, synchronously, on the next line**, assigns `window.location.href = crossSiteUrl(...)`. `handleDismiss` does the same cookie write, closes, never navigates.

`EU_LANGUAGE_CONFIG` is the language→site/display map from the brief, verified against `config/sites.overlay.js:39-42` (all four alias/locale pairs matched exactly) and against the four `LanguageDetected*` Storybook stories Marcel already approved (all `inCountry`/`inLanguage`/`inCurrentLanguage`/`target` values match).

### Pass criteria — evidence for each

- **`npx tsc --noEmit` → exit 0, no output.** Confirmed on the final state.
- **`npm run test` → 0 failures, count strictly increasing.** Pre-existing baseline (captured before I touched anything): **82 files / 1228 tests / 0 failures**. Final: **83 files / 1238 tests / 0 failures** — +1 file, +10 tests (9 in the new container's test, 1 new positive test in `_app/index.test.tsx`), matching exactly what I added.
- **SFCC-863 and SFCC-885 suites pass completely unmodified.** Ran both in isolation via `-t "SFCC-863"` (2/2 pass) and `-t "SFCC-885"` (4/4 pass) — both before my `_app/index.test.tsx` edit and again after. `git diff` on that file shows only `+` lines, zero `-` lines, in every hunk.
- **`_app/index.tsx` diff ≤3 real lines.** Exactly 2 (`git diff -U0` output shown above).
- **Cookie-before-navigate ordering, demonstrated red-then-green.** Reversed the implementation to navigate-then-cookie, ran the test: **red** — `expected 7 to be less than 5` (the cookie write's call-order index was actually *after* the navigation's). Restored, reran: **green**. This used `mock.invocationCallOrder` on the mocked `setRegionPrefCookie` and a `vi.stubGlobal('location', {set href...})` spy — the same `vi.stubGlobal('location', ...)` technique already established in this exact codebase at `zimmColourSwatch/index.test.tsx:138-139`, extended with a setter so the assignment moment is independently orderable.
- **`npm run lint` → clean versus baseline.** Baseline (captured before any edit): **886 problems (831 errors, 55 warnings)**, all pre-existing and unrelated (header, product-view, zimmButton, footerShared, C1's own `crossSiteUrl.ts`/`shouldShowLanguagePrompt.test.ts`, etc. — none of it mine to fix per "never refactor upward"). Final: **886 problems (831 errors, 55 warnings) — byte-identical.** I did catch one real thing along the way: my first draft carried a defensive `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` above the mount effect, matching 3 existing precedents in this repo — but this project's config doesn't actually flag that pattern, so the directive itself showed up as a *new* "unused eslint-disable directive" warning. Removed it; back to zero new problems.
- **`npm run audit:tokens` → still exactly 3, none new.** Confirmed identical output before and after — my new files are components/utils, no `.css.ts`, no raw hex/px/rem/em.
- **`ZimmIcon` mocked transitively.** `index.test.tsx` mocks `ZimmCountryLanguageMismatch` wholesale, so `ZimmButton`→`ZimmIcon`→the base icons barrel is never reached in that suite. In `_app/index.test.tsx`, I reproduced the exact predicted failure *live* before adding the mock — `TypeError: Cannot create property 'viewBox' on string '.../cc-amex.svg'` — confirming the plan's own diagnosis was accurate, not theoretical, then fixed it with the mock.
- **`useMultiSite` mocked with a factory wherever touched.** `_app/index.test.tsx`'s existing factory-style mock is untouched; my container never calls `useMultiSite` itself (by design).

### Fail-on-purpose, done for all four required assertions (not just the mandatory one)

Each: broke it, ran the specific test, confirmed red, restored, confirmed green.

`EU_LANGUAGE_CONFIG`'s four alias/locale pairs are hand-typed to match `config/sites.overlay.js` — I verified them match today, but nothing keeps them matching.
